components.name: Accordion
components.description: A vertically stacked set of interactive disclosure headers that each reveal a section of content, supporting single or multiple expanded items.

components.name: AgentKindChip
components.description: A non-interactive identity mark for one coding-agent kind (`claude`, `pi`, `opencode`, `agy`, `codex`, `hermes`, `copilot`), in two displays: a `label` pill (icon + visible name) built from `Badge variant="neutral"`, and a `glyph` disc (icon only) built from `Avatar` with its `fallback` slot.

components.name: Alert
components.description: A boxed banner for surfacing feedback tied to a page or a completed action — form submission results, background-task outcomes, standing warnings — in 4 semantic variants (`info`/`success`/`warning`/`danger`), each wired to the correct ARIA live-region role by default.

components.name: AttentionBadge
components.description: A mark that says "a human is needed here" for one of four reasons — `grill` (questions to answer), `compare` (a verdict to give), `permission` (a decision to grant or deny), `stuck` (a session needs action).

components.name: Avatar
components.description: A round identity mark with a three-step fallback chain: a lazy-loaded `image` (`src`) first, `initials` derived from `name` when there is no image or it fails to load, and an `icon` (`fallback` prop, defaulting to a person glyph) when there is no name to derive from.

components.name: Badge
components.description: A small inline label with two shapes on one `variant` axis: eight **tones** (`primary` … `neutral`) that render a purely presentational tinted `<span>`, and **`chip`**, a pill on the shared control scale that can toggle (`onSelect`) and/or be removed (`onDismiss`) with real button semantics.

components.name: BottomNav
components.description: A mobile bottom tab bar: a labelled `<nav>` landmark containing up to 5 items, each with an icon and a label, safe-area-aware on iOS.

components.name: BottomNavDrawer
components.description: A non-modal drawer that lives **behind** a `BottomNav` and grows upward out of the bar's top edge — the Apple Music mini player / Maps sheet over a tab bar.

components.name: Breadcrumbs
components.description: A secondary navigation hierarchy trail indicating the user's current location within a site or application structure.

components.name: Button
components.description: A native `<button>` wrapper with variant/size theming, an optional loading state, and leading/trailing icon slots.

components.name: Card
components.description: A container that groups related content into a distinct surface, with a variant axis for the surface treatment, three render modes (plain container, link card, selectable choice card), and five subcomponents (`CardHeader`, `CardTitle`, `CardDescription`, `CardContent`, `CardFooter`).

components.name: Checkbox
components.description: A native `<input type="checkbox">` visually hidden (`sr-only`) behind a styled decorative box, with support for the tri-state `indeterminate` visual (set imperatively via a ref callback, since `indeterminate` isn't a settable DOM attribute).

components.name: Code
components.description: Inline code in the mono family.

components.name: ColorPicker
components.description: A form field that picks one colour.

components.name: ConfirmDialog
components.description: A specialized modal dialog for critical confirmations, destructive actions (e.g. deletions), and alerts, with preconfigured icon accents, action buttons, and loading states.

components.name: DataList
components.description: A generic, generic-typed `<T>` list/grid renderer with three interchangeable rendering modes (virtualized, paginated, infinite-scroll), plus built-in search, sort, single/multi selection, and a roving-focus keyboard model.

components.name: DatePicker
components.description: A single-date text-trigger + popover calendar control.

components.name: DateRangePicker
components.description: A single trigger button that opens a popover calendar for picking a start and end date as one range.

components.name: DiffStat
components.description: A GitHub-style diff summary: `+additions` / `-deletions` counts in text plus a 5-block strip that fills green-to-red by share of additions.

components.name: DisclosureButton
components.description: A ghost text trigger with a trailing chevron-down, for opening something: a menu, a popover, a listbox.

components.name: Divider
components.description: A one-pixel rule that separates content, horizontally or vertically.

components.name: Drawer
components.description: A draggable edge-anchored panel rendered as a native `<dialog>` in the top layer — no portal.

components.name: DropdownMenu
components.description: An action menu popover anchored to a trigger button, displaying a list of contextual actions, commands, toggles, and destructive operations with full WAI-ARIA Menu semantics.

components.name: EmptyState
components.description: A clean, visual placeholder displayed when data is absent, filtered out, or newly initialized, providing clear explanation and next-step actions.

components.name: FileInput
components.description: A form field that picks files, validates them against `accept`/size/count, optionally crops (`ImageCropper` in a `Modal`) and compresses images (`src/lib/image`), then hands the resulting `File[]` to `onChange`.

components.name: FooterBar
components.description: A bottom action bar: a top hairline boundary over a surface row with a **leading** slot and a **trailing** slot for icon buttons or actions.

components.name: FormField
components.description: A compound form layout container that manages accessible label linkage (`htmlFor`), description hints (`aria-describedby`), required markers (`*`), and error validation alerts (`role="alert"`) across form control primitives.

components.name: Frame
components.description: The sizing and padding box — SwiftUI's `.frame()` and `.padding()` expressed as one component.

components.name: Grid
components.description: A responsive CSS grid container that maps numeric or breakpoint-responsive column counts to static Tailwind class lookups.

components.name: HStack
components.description: A horizontal `Stack`.

components.name: Heading
components.description: A polymorphic heading typography primitive rendering semantic heading tags (`h1` through `h6`) or layout tags (`span`, `div`) with responsive, token-driven sizing, font family selection, weights, alignment, color variants, and truncation.

components.name: HeatCell
components.description: One cell of a heatmap: a square swatch whose brand fill strength encodes a value in `0..1`.

components.name: IconPicker
components.description: A picker for choosing one icon name from the app's icon registry (`ALL_ICON_NAMES` / `getIconComponent` in `@/lib/icon-registry`), in two shapes: a collapsible popover **grid** with an input trigger and category filter pills (default), or a **dropdown** combobox built on `SearchableSelect` that opens on click/focus and lists each icon glyph next to its name.

components.name: IconTile
components.description: A fixed-footprint tinted square (`shape="rounded"`) or disc (`shape="full"`) that holds one icon, or a short numeral / initials string.

components.name: ImageCropper
components.description: An inline, controlled crop editor for one raster image `Blob`: a stage showing the image with a movable, resizable crop box (four corner handles), a zoom `Slider`, and an optional aspect switcher.

components.name: Input
components.description: A labeled, single-line text input with built-in hint/error messaging, optional clear button, character counter, and lightweight validation.

components.name: Kbd
components.description: A keyboard key chip: a native `<kbd>` in the mono family with a `border-border bg-elevation-2` surface at the `xxs` text size.

components.name: ListItem
components.description: One interactive row: a `leading` slot, a two-line label (`title` plus an optional `subtitle`), and a `trailing` slot, rendered as a single native control with hover, focus-visible and pressed states.

components.name: Logo
components.description: The official brand logo component.

components.name: MessageBubble
components.description: A chat bubble: one message in a conversation.

components.name: Modal
components.description: A native `<dialog>` opened with `showModal()`: the platform supplies the top layer, `::backdrop`, inert page, focus containment, focus return and `Escape`/back-gesture close.

components.name: OptimizedImage
components.description: A framework-agnostic `` wrapper that adds intersection-observer lazy loading, a generated `srcSet`/`sizes` responsive chain, a shimmer/blur placeholder while loading, and an error fallback state.

components.name: OtpInput
components.description: A segmented one-time-password (OTP) and PIN input primitive rendering N distinct character boxes while managing a single accessible, hidden native input element equipped with `autoComplete="one-time-code"`.

components.name: PageHeader
components.description: The title block at the top of a page: optional eyebrow, a `Heading` at `level={1}` (size `3xl`), a muted description, and page-level actions.

components.name: Pagination
components.description: A navigation component enabling users to traverse multi-page datasets with numbered page pills, ellipsis compression, jump-to-page, and page-size selection.

components.name: PasswordField
components.description: A specialized password entry primitive that wraps `Input` with built-in caps-lock warning, dependency-free password strength calculation, confirm-password matching, and automated autocomplete attribute resolution.

components.name: Popover
components.description: An anchored hint card (native `popover` in the top layer, no portal) that renders rich supplementary content, an optional title, an icon-only close button, and an optional action button with a directional pointer arrow, matching macOS-style popover hints and Tooltip surface styling.

components.name: Progress
components.description: A non-interactive indicator of how much of a task is done (determinate) or that it is still running (indeterminate).

components.name: RadioGroup
components.description: A set of checkable radio buttons where at most one option can be selected at a time.

components.name: RowList
components.description: A static `<ul>` of rows.

components.name: ScrollView
components.description: A responsive scroll container supporting horizontal and vertical directions, edge gradient fades (`fadeEdges`), directional navigation arrows (`showArrows`), CSS scroll snap points (`snap`), mouse wheel horizontal translation, scrollbar customization, and breakpoint-based unwrapping (`wrapAt`).

components.name: SearchableSelect
components.description: An open-form combobox: a text input that filters a virtualized popup listbox as the user types, with highlight-on-match and an optional clear button.

components.name: Section
components.description: A semantic `<section>` element that renders a structured header (title + description + actions) followed by content.

components.name: Select
components.description: A custom (non-native) single-select combobox: a button trigger showing the current value plus a top-layer popup `<ul role="listbox">` of options, with full keyboard nav and single-character typeahead.

components.name: Skeleton
components.description: An animated placeholder for content that is still loading, mimicking the shape and dimensions of future text, avatars, media, or cards.

components.name: Slider
components.description: A single-thumb range control built on a `role="slider"` `<div>` (not a native `<input type="range">`), with pointer-drag-anywhere-on-track and full arrow/Home/End/PageUp/ PageDown keyboard support.

components.name: SocialButton
components.description: A presentation-only button primitive implementing the official brand guidelines for third-party identity providers: Google, Apple, GitHub, and Microsoft.

components.name: Spacer
components.description: A flexible, invisible gap that eats the free space of its flex parent.

components.name: SplitPane
components.description: A two-pane scaffold: an optional `header` over a `sidebar` | divider | `detail` split.

components.name: Stack
components.description: The base flexbox layout primitive every other stack is built from.

components.name: StatusDot
components.description: A small presence/status dot: a solid circle in one of six semantic tones with a required accessible name.

components.name: StatusRail
components.description: A thin, purely decorative coloured bar that marks a surface's state along one edge: vertical along the leading edge of a card (needs-decision), or horizontal across the top of a column.

components.name: Stepper
components.description: A non-interactive indicator of progress through a labelled sequence (checkout, onboarding, multi-stage startup).

components.name: Swatch
components.description: A colour chip: a small filled circle that shows one caller-provided colour.

components.name: SwatchPicker
components.description: A single-select picker for 2–8 curated named colours.

components.name: Switch
components.description: A `<button role="switch">` toggle (not a native input) with a sliding-thumb visual, sized via the shared `SizeTier` scale.

components.name: Table
components.description: A native `<table>` inside a focusable, labelled horizontal scroll region.

components.name: Tabs
components.description: A compound component (`Tabs` + `TabList` + `Tab` + `TabPanel`) implementing the standard tablist pattern with automatic-activation arrow-key navigation and Tab-through-tabs focus.

components.name: Text
components.description: A versatile, polymorphic body typography primitive rendering semantic paragraph, phrasing, or inline elements (`p`, `span`, `div`, `label`, `strong`, `em`, `small`, `blockquote`, `code`) with token-driven sizing (`caption`, `3xs` through `3xl`), semantic color variants, font families, alignment, weight, and truncation.

components.name: Toast
components.description: A `ToastProvider` context + `useToast()` imperative API for ephemeral, stacked, auto-dismissing notifications, rendered in the native top layer (`popover="manual"`, shown on mount, no portal).

components.name: Tooltip
components.description: A hover/focus-triggered label shown as a `popover="manual"` (top layer, no portal) and placed by CSS Anchor Positioning.

components.name: TypingIndicator
components.description: Three dots that pulse in sequence to show someone is composing a message.

components.name: VStack
components.description: A vertical `Stack`.

components.name: VirtualList
components.description: A generic, DOM-windowed list renderer for `T[]`.

components.name: ZStack
components.description: An overlay primitive that layers its children on top of each other.

components.name: ActivityFeed
components.description: A card listing activity events — actor avatar, "actor action" line, timestamp, and an optional tone tag — in a real `<ol>`.

components.name: AppShell
components.description: The top-level page frame: a sticky `NavHeader` plus a `<main>` content region.

components.name: CheckoutSummary
components.description: A card listing cart line items with quantities and prices, a `dl` price breakdown (subtotal/shipping/tax/total), and a full-width checkout button.

components.name: DashboardShell
components.description: A comprehensive dashboard layout pattern composing an icon/navigation rail `Sidebar`, top navigation header via `AppShell`/`NavHeader`, and a primary `<main>` content area.

components.name: DataTable
components.description: A generic, virtualized data table (`DataTable<T>`) with client-side search, single-column sort, and an automatic mobile card layout — built on `VirtualList` for windowed rendering, so row count doesn't bound DOM size.

components.name: FilterBar
components.description: A search input + sort dropdown + removable active-filter chips toolbar, with the sort control collapsing behind a "Filters" toggle button on narrow screens.

components.name: KanbanCard
components.description: One ticket tile on a board: ticket key, a category chip, a status icon with its name, a title, up to three labels, an optional blocked note, and a footer (counter, description marker, branch).

components.name: ListDetailView
components.description: A master-detail pattern component presenting a collection of items via either a responsive `DataTable` or virtualized `VirtualList`, paired with a slide-over `Drawer` detail panel when an item is selected.

components.name: LoginCard
components.description: A sign-in card composed of `Card`, `Alert`, `SocialButton`, `Input`, `PasswordField`, `Button` and `Divider`.

components.name: NavHeader
components.description: The application's single sticky top nav — the entire app chrome, no left rail.

components.name: NavTree
components.description: A generic, three-level collapsible navigation tree — group, item, and variant — built for sidebars that mix a flat set of top-level links with a large, searchable catalog.

components.name: NotificationCenter
components.description: A card listing notification items with an unread-count badge, an optional "mark all read" action, and per-item dismiss/select callbacks.

components.name: OrderStatusCard
components.description: An order-tracking tile composed of `Card`, `Heading`, `Text`, `Badge` and `Button`: order id, status badge, a four-step fulfilment timeline (placed → packed → shipped → delivered), summary, ETA and actions.

components.name: PricingCard
components.description: A single pricing-plan tile composed of `Card`, `Heading`, `Text`, `Badge` and `Button`: plan name, price with cadence, a feature checklist and one call to action.

components.name: ProfileHeader
components.description: A person/account header composed of `Card`, `Avatar`, `Heading`, `Text`, `Badge` and `Grid`: avatar, name, subtitle, bio, tags, a stats row and an actions slot.

components.name: SettingsPage
components.description: A structured settings page pattern composing card-based form sections (`SettingsSection`), input controls (`FormField`, `Input`), and standard primary/cancel action buttons.

components.name: SettingsSheet
components.description: A right-edge slide-in panel for settings/detail forms: a titled body inside a right-side `Drawer` (native `<dialog>` opened with `showModal()`), so the platform supplies the top layer, inert page, focus containment, Escape and light dismiss, and scroll lock.

components.name: Sidebar
components.description: Primary product navigation rendered two ways from one item list: a permanent, icon-only compact rail on desktop (`lg:` and up) and an off-canvas drawer with full text labels on smaller screens.

components.name: StatCard
components.description: A presentational dashboard tile showing one labeled metric with an icon and an optional up/down delta indicator.

components.name: StudioLayout
components.description: The two-column shell a tool page uses: a configuration sidebar that sticks under the nav header and scrolls its own overflow, beside a fluid main column that holds the output.

components.name: TeamList
components.description: A card listing team members with avatar, name, role, optional email, a member-count badge, an invite action, and per-member remove buttons.
